subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The prisoners made an elaborate plan to escape ______ the jail.
solution:
The correct answer is **'from'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about the prisoners making a plan to escape the jail.
 
• The preposition 'from' is used to indicate the starting point of the action, which in this case is the jail.

Therefore, the correct option is **'from'**.</p&g
